900001:1187.name: V1.0.0修正版本发布，由于完整版移动端组件与开发实现差异化很大，且暂无开发资源进行开发方面的补齐，故发布该修正版作为临时版本进行过渡，该版本基于之前移动端完美版组件进行体验/视觉衰减，与现有开发版本进行对齐，保证开发/设计组件一致性，后期有开发资源支持开始逐步往完整版组件靠齐； 当前发布版本对图标库规范进行了调整整套图标视觉规范已对齐vant图标库； 表单容器进行调整、文本尺寸进行调整； 按钮容器、文本尺寸进行了调整；

Released the V1.0.0 interim revision. The complete mobile design library differed substantially from the available implementation, and development resources were not yet available to close the gap. This revision reduces some visual and interaction details to match the current implementation and keep design and code consistent. The full version remains the long-term target as development resources become available.
Aligned the full icon set with Vant icon guidelines.
Adjusted form containers and text sizes.
Adjusted button containers and text sizes.
